chapter_title: Concerning the Purification of these Four Elements
spiritual_reading:
A complete sufficiency of fundamental principles in a person was originally received in purity. In its first state it was set apart for the Divine, filled with living power, and capable of illumination. But when understanding entered into conflict at the first assault of evil, what was useless and rejected became mingled into those principles, and an opposing falsity from evil was conjoined with them. When these principles were brought down into the outer life, they put away the defiled outer appearances that had clung to them and pressed those defilements into the merely natural self. The impurities that were cast off did not vanish; they were held for manifestation in a lower plane and became a hazard to the outer life.

From the love-principle, when it is defiled, there comes an outflow that is forced out and lodged in the outer life; this outflow is falsified truth made vivid in the person. From that falsified truth there breaks forth contentious zeal. From contentious zeal there proceeds a spread of disordered states in the natural mind.

Likewise, from the truth-principle, when it is defiled, there are outflows that it expels from itself; these outflows are unchaste craving. From unchaste craving there proceeds aversion to good and truth. From that aversion there arises a consuming agitation of the natural life.

From the wisdom-principle, when it is defiled, there is an outflow it expels: a merely external life severed from inner spirit. From that merely external life there proceeds obscurity of understanding. From obscurity of understanding there arises a fixed resistance against reformation.

From perverted perception there are outflows it expels: persuasive impulses that proclaim disgrace and self-condemnation. What follows from those persuasive impulses in their final outflow is unclear in this text; it may be the completion of their effect as a binding of the mind into further disorder.

From sorrow in the lower self there comes forth the final outflow that completes this series of twelve corrupt outgoings.

After this, these fundamental principles are again ordered for purification. What had been gathered into the person is discovered and arranged through the guidance of the nourishment of the inner life that is received into the outer life. When these principles are brought into the outer life in right order, they are cleansed and purified and fixed in their living form, which is the regenerated person. They then live according to that order, receive an enlightened understanding from the Divine, and are purified into that likeness; and they come forth cleansed and set apart. In this they reach their first state of peace.

fills.notes: The clause defines the four elements by function: they are that which is purified (i.e., the purifiable principles). Keeping the impersonal substrate register.
Correspondentially this is the first collision of understanding with invading evil; the substrate typically speaks of the ‘enemy’ and its ‘assault’ rather than moral exhortation.
The stripped pollutions are not annihilated but set for manifestation in a lower plane; ‘lower place’ keeps the cosmological, non-institutional register (rather than moralizing terms).

The ‘voices of the winds of shame’ are persuasive self-condemning impulses; their next discrete effect is a fixed internal binding, here rendered as ‘hardness of heart’ (obstinate closure), matching the chain-pattern of emissions producing a more fixed state.
The tear corresponds to sorrow in the lower self; its emission is said to be the finishing-term of the twelve, so ‘completion’ fits the structural function better than a new symptom-name.
Marks the turn from the twelve corrupt outgoings to the re-ordering and purification cycle; a simple temporal pivot suits the impersonal substrate.
The sentence requires the stated end of the elements’ re-entry into the body: purification. ‘Be cleansed’ matches the repeated ‘cleansed and purified’ that follows.

The spiritual sense requires that the regenerated principles ‘live’ in a restored arrangement; ‘according to their order’ matches the management and establishing language and avoids later devotional phrasing.

assessment: Most lacunae are short and are recoverable by the chapter’s strict causal chain (element → emission → more fixed disorder) and by the structural pivot in ¶8 from defilement to re-ordering. Two places remain only moderately constrained: ¶2 #2 (the exact phrasing for the first conflict) and ¶6 #1 (the specific final effect of the shame-winds). The restorations there follow the correspondential demand for ‘enemy assault’ and for a hardening or binding terminal state.
